Supported by Artsfas, Yayasan Hasanah

Looking for a fun evening plan with family and friends? Join us at Festival Budaya Malaysia 2026 at Taman Tasik Titiwangsa for a captivating live storytelling session of Malaysia's rich heritage! 

Dive into Malaysia's cultural history featuring the legendary tales of Puteri Saadong and Puteri Hang Li Po, brought to life by the wonderful Tun Alia and Ummi Sham!

Unwind by the lake while immersing yourself in the rich folklore, traditions, and history that shape our identity.

✨️📚 SATURDAY STORYTELLING SESSION 📚✨

We had another magical afternoon at Hikayat Fandom Gallery! 

Pak Pen and Ummi Sham took our audience on a wonderful journey through classic folklore. Pak Pen shared the clever tale of *Sang Kancil Penjaga Bengkung Diraja*, while Ummi Sham brought to life the captivating story of *Puteri Hang Li Po*. 

Together, their performances filled the room with wonder, imagination, and adventure for guests of all ages. 

A big thank you to everyone who joined us! 

We hope to see you again at our next Hikayat Storytelling session. Hikayat Storytelling is held every Saturday at 3.00pm at Hikayat Fandom Gallery, GMBB, Level 1-47, No. 2 Jalan Robertson, Bukit Bintang.

Come experience the magic of storytelling with us! ✨

Selamat Menyambut Hari Kebangsaan ke-69! 🇲🇾✨

Di Hikayat Fandom, kami percaya bahawa setiap hikayat dan cerita mempunyai keunikan untuk menyatukan kita semua. 

Tahun ini, kita melaungkan semangat Merdeka dengan penuh rasa bangga dan syukur, sementara meraikan tradisi hikayat dan cerita rakyat demi jati diri dan maruah bangsa. 

Malaysia bukan sekadar sebuah negara, tetapi satu masyarakat harmoni dibina bersama. Daripada pelbagai latar, budaya dan bangsa, kita terus melangkah sebagai satu.

Semoga semangat perpaduan, dan kecintaan terhadap tanah air terus mekar dalam diri kita semua. 

Daripada kami di Hikayat Fandom,
Selamat Hari Merdeka! 🇲🇾

HIKAYAT FANDOM
